notes: v0.3.87: Hardened seamless rejoin (adversarial-review fixes on 0.3.86). The rejoin retarget now adopts the address the returning peer's hole-punches actually arrive from (ground truth) and otherwise mirrors the original session's proven path — never a blind same-IP LAN guess, so the 'same WiFi, no audio' bug class stays dead. A disconnect can no longer spawn a phantom room-camper; a session that comes back to life after the 10-minute window recovers instead of being killed; relay mode no longer shows a clock-skew latency number; and the legacy red banner can't flash before the amber waiting banner.
